narrative.overview: The page is a night match. The hero is a canvas stadium the visitor lights up by scoring; the floodlights coming on is Pitchy's job made literal. Below the hero the page stays in night navy and mown-pitch green, then turns to match-programme paper (white panels, hairlines, ink numerals) where the visitor installs. Dark means "look", paper means "do".
keyCharacteristics: Night navy grounds, pitch-green stripe bands, warm flood white for light only.
One action colour (teal, pill-shaped) on dark and on paper.
Condensed display type at weight 800 over a hyperlegible body, tabular numerals page-wide.
Dark sections flat and bordered; paper sections lifted with soft shadow.
Pitch-stripe strips mark the move from night to paper (full-width section band) and cap the sheet; never a rail on a rounded card.
44px minimum targets, 3px focus ring, reduced-motion honoured.

rules.name: The Light-Only Rule
rules.body: Flood white marks something lit or current. It is never a background, border or decoration.

rules.name: The One Action Rule
rules.body: Teal is the only button fill. Platform green and blue identify a platform and never act as buttons.

rules.name: The Paper Switch Rule
rules.body: Install, sheet and FAQ sit on paper with ink text; the focus ring changes to teal there. Night and paper do not mix inside one panel.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Numerals are tabular page-wide; scores, steps and times never shift width.

rules.name: The Condensed-Heads Rule
rules.body: Display face for headings and numerals only; never for running text or buttons.

rules.name: The Night Is Flat Rule
rules.body: On night grounds, structure comes from hairlines and tone steps, not shadows; shadows are for objects that float above the scene.

dos: Do keep teal (#0e6b52) as the only action fill and flood white (#fff4d6) for light only.
Do use the display face for headings and numerals and the body face for everything read.
Do switch to paper (#f5f7fa, white panels, hairlines, ink text) for install, sheet and FAQ, and swap the focus ring to teal there.
Do keep every target at least 44px and keep the 3px focus ring.
Do show real app screenshots with sample data in frames; keep downloads visibly "coming soon" until a real release exists.
Do keep the pitch-stripe strip as the night-to-paper marker.
donts: Don't use a gradient-backed hero mockup plus a feature-card grid; the hero is the playable pitch.
Don't use safety colours (red, amber, green status) as decoration.
Don't invent testimonials, partners, versions, sizes or URLs.
Don't use flood white as a surface or border, or teal on a non-action.
Don't put shadows on dark section surfaces other than floating objects.
